violations.text: Handwashing signage is lacking at sink in downstairs bathroom and kitchen.PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 07/15/2026

The door to the outside, located in the (near bar area ), is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 07/15/2026

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the (kitchen) area. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. New Violation. Correct By: 07/15/2026
The (walls ) in the (kitchen and basement ) area is in poor repair. Observed holes. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 08/14/2026

The floors in basement storage room have an accumulation of soil residue and/or food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 07/15/2026
Establishment is lacking an allergen statement. New Violation. Correct By: 04/04/2024

The door to the outside, located in the kitchen, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 04/04/2024

At the time of inspection, faucet located at the 3 bay sink bar was not able to reach all three sinks. PIC informed that faucet needs to reach all three sinks to effectively wash, rinse and sanitize. New Violation. Correct By: 04/04/2024
